title: Descartes Winter Colloquium (t.b.a.)
description: Descartes Centre end-of-year colloquium on history & philosophy of science (replaces the UPAC Colloquium this week). Programme and room t.b.a.; in past years this was a festive session of short talks by Descartes Centre members. Hybrid; e-mail dc-colloquium@uu.nl for the Teams link.
